The coordinator's credential, native conversation, project object, and Room scope are re-derived. The recipient's registration is current. | Recognized work. An EISA submission supplies the constitutional act and its evidence handles.
  • 1. Git and Chat Are Necessary—and Insufficient [Part 1/5]: Git is an excellent source-history plane. Chat is an excellent human and model communication surface. The Room does not replace either. It prevents their artifacts from impersonating live authority.
